A selection of works attributed to the Buddha himself, many of which feature in the Kangyur (bka' 'gyur), the Tibetan canonical collection of the Buddha's Word:

Aspiration Prayers

Auspiciousness

Dhāraṇī

The Dhāraṇī of Amitāyus
This brief invocation of Buddha Amitāyus, featured in the Nyingma Mönlam, combines the famous four-line Praise of Amitāyus with the mantra and passages from The Sūtra of Boundless Life and Wisdom.
Longevity Amitāyus Dhāraṇī Nyingma Mönlam 4 Dec 2020
